title: Which groups he enjoyed most and the Ink Spots
summary: The Spirits were his favorite; Louis Jordan, Ink Spots, Edgar Hayes and others were jobs, and he never recorded with the Ink Spots.

bands.name: Louis Jordan and His Tympany Five

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Well, from a musical point of view, like of all the groups you worked with -- once you came out here you worked with Louis Jourdan and with the Ink Spots, with -- these are people you actually worked with, and extensively, you know.
The Spirits of Rhythm I came out here with.
Yeah, but then, after the Spirits broke up and Leo died and so forth.
After that you worked with Louis Jordan.
And you had some groups of your own.
Of all those groups what was your -- from a musical point of view what did you enjoy the most?
What did I enjoy the most?
When you still had the Spirits together?
Well, how about the other groups afterwards? Was it pretty much just --
Just a matter of a job.
You never recorded with the Ink Spots that year --
-- that you were on tour with them?
That's a shame, because I would have liked to have heard what you did with them.
Yeah. During the years they was strong.
Yeah. Hoppy and all them, you know.
[Deak.] Yeah. I wondered why they didn't like they did. stay together, but they didn't. It's a shame. Most of them's gone now.
